channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: What do you call a young coal digger?
item.description:
What do you call a young coal digger?
A minor miner.

item.title: How did the moose begin the letter to his cousin?
item.description:
How did the moose begin the letter to his cousin?
Dear Deer.

item.title: What do you call a lazy statue?
item.description:
What do you call a lazy statue?
An idle idol.

item.title: What do you call a scary bear?
item.description:
What do you call a scary bear?
A grisly grizzly.

item.title: What did the teddy bear say after dinner?
item.description:
What did the teddy bear say after dinner?
I'm stuffed.

item.title: How do you catch a fish without a fishing pole?
item.description:
How do you catch a fish without a fishing pole?
With your BEAR hands.

item.title: What do you call strawberries playing the guitar?
item.description:
What do you call strawberries playing the guitar?
A jam session!

item.title: Why couldn't the sesame leave the casino?
item.description:
Why couldn't the sesame leave the casino?
Because he was on a roll!

item.title: Why do bananas wear suntan lotions?
item.description:
Why do bananas wear suntan lotions?
Because they are prone to peeling!

item.title: What type of fruit can fix your sink?
item.description:
What type of fruit can fix your sink?
A plum-ber!
